data.title: BNPL Item-Not-Received Claim Velocity
data.description: Detects accounts filing three or more item-not-received (INR) claims within a 90-day rolling window where the average disputed order value exceeds $300. Legitimate INR dispute rates are under 1% of orders, with most disputes involving genuine delivery failures. Organized phantom delivery fraud and friendly fraud operations systematically file INR claims after receiving goods, targeting high-value orders to maximize returns. This rule supports TP-0040 Phase 4 detection by identifying accounts exhibiting claim patterns consistent with organized INR abuse rather than genuine delivery issues. The $300 average threshold filters out low-value legitimate disputes while capturing the high-value targeting characteristic of organized fraud.
falsepositives: Legitimate delivery failures in areas with known courier reliability issues
Bulk purchasers with higher absolute dispute counts due to high order volumes
Seasonal delivery disruptions during peak shipping periods
